audit_readiness.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive competence gates; not noninferiority or unchanged internal confidence.

definitions.baseline: No hook: zero injection counts and unavailable event distributions.
definitions.cap: Audited cap_hit; reaching4096 is also reported even when final token is EOS.
definitions.cumulative: Sums of successive local events, not net displacement, persistent state or psychological intensity.
definitions.dose: Every nonzero arm uses the positive C raw norm times its signed applied unit, not its own contrast norm.
definitions.geometry: Saved scalar ledgers validated by main audit; no independent decode residual reconstruction.
definitions.projection_increment: Positive along each signed applied unit; the primary is negative on original C. Different arms do not share a psychological scale.
definitions.quantiles: Empirical linear5th/50th/95th percentiles, min/max and mean; no intervals.
definitions.weighting: Geometry weights events; lengths and cumulative exposure weight assigned rows equally.
definitions.zero_sham: Real zero-dose hook events with zero perturbation geometry.

limitations: Response length is post-intervention; exposure cannot be treated as a pretreatment covariate.
All assigned choices and diagnostics retained without service, correctness or readiness filtering.
Uses shared frozen summary helpers and authoritative audit; this is not an independent execution certification.
